When does New Year 2027 start in Chile?

Chile spans 2 different UTC offsets on New Year's Eve, so 2027 arrives in waves. The first region to celebrate is Santiago (UTC-03:00) at 03:00 UTC on Friday, January 1, 2027, and the last is Easter Island (UTC-05:00), 2 hours later.

The countdown above follows Santiago, where midnight falls at 03:00 UTC.

On December 31 Santiago is on daylight saving time, so the offset is UTC-03:00 instead of the standard UTC-04:00.

New Year's Day 2027 falls on a Friday.

Chile in the global New Year countdown

The first places on Earth to enter 2027 are the Line Islands of Kiribati (UTC+14:00). Santiago follows 17 hours later, and the last inhabited places, American Samoa and Niue (UTC-11:00), celebrate 8 hours after Santiago.

When the clock strikes midnight in Santiago, 162 of the 196 countries in our world time zone table already have at least one region celebrating 2027.

  • Just before (UTC-02:00): Brazil (Fernando de Noronha)
  • Just after (UTC-03:30): Canada (St. John's)

Who celebrates at the same time as Chile?

These countries also reach midnight at UTC-03:00, so they welcome 2027 at exactly the same moment as Santiago: Argentina, Brazil (São Paulo), Paraguay, Uruguay and Suriname.

New Year traditions in Chile

The fireworks over the bay of Valparaíso are the biggest New Year show in the country. Many Chileans also eat a spoonful of lentils for prosperity and run around with a suitcase to attract travel.

Frequently asked questions

What time is New Year 2027 in Chile in UTC?

Midnight in Santiago corresponds to 03:00 UTC on Friday, January 1, 2027. Other regions of Chile follow, up to 2 hours apart.

How many time zones does Chile have on New Year's Eve?

Chile uses 2 different UTC offsets on December 31, from UTC-03:00 in Santiago to UTC-05:00 in Easter Island.

Is daylight saving time in effect in Chile on New Year's Eve?

Yes. On December 31 Santiago uses UTC-03:00; its standard time is UTC-04:00.

Which countries celebrate New Year just before Chile?

The previous time zone to reach midnight is UTC-02:00, which includes Brazil (Fernando de Noronha).
